messages:
mira_ml: Quick heads-up — fenrir-lite v1 q4 PTQ onboarding shows small but consistent regressions on zh->en and ar->en slices. Suspect token merges + bidi detok flips.
alex_tokenizer: can you paste a couple of failing lines so i can check token boundaries?
mira_ml: two representative dev examples below (deduped):
[1] src: 我今天去了公园，看见一个孩子在放风筝。
ref: I went to the park today and saw a child flying a kite.
q4_out: I went to the park today and saw a kid fly a kite.
q8_out: I went to the park today and saw a child flying a kite.
[2] src: قال "(هذا اختبار)" امام الجمهور.
ref: He said "(This is a test)" in front of the audience.
q4_out: He said "(This is a test)" in front of the audience.
q8_out: He said ")This is a test(" in front of the audience.
sam_infra: CI summary: comparing q8 baseline -> q4 candidate, zh->en BLEU down ~0.9, ar->en down ~1.1; cost/latency improving.
nora_locale: see more bracket mirror cases in mixed RTL/Latin. Looks tied to detok postproc in some runs.
alex_tokenizer: tokenizer.json unchanged. i'll run a token-dump repro to see if merge happens pre-detok or during detok.
mira_ml: my working hypothesis: quant kernels changed softmax ordering for punctuation/space tokens near boundaries; coupled with detok bidi heuristics causes mirror flips.
sam_infra: launching q4 with older kernelset (runtime v0.9.5) to test kernel influence. job started: https://ci.internal/84211
ci-bot: Job 84211 started by sam_infra.
sam_infra: quick result: switching q4 -> runtime v0.9.5 reduces zh->en BLEU gap to ~0.15 and ar->en to ~0.2. Kernelset looks dominant.
mira_ml: good signal. plan: 1) block kernel rollout for q4 kernels, 2) add bidi/parens smoke tests to evals, 3) add token-dump repro and unit tests, 4) open regression ticket with samples.
nora_locale: i'll add a small bidi bracket suite (evals/locale/bidi_parens.json) and a smoke CI check.
alex_tokenizer: i'll push repro + test PR and attach token dumps to ticket. ETA EOD.
sam_infra: i'll prepare rollback and a kernel-diff for runtime team.
ci-bot: Regression ticket created ML-3347 by nora_locale: https://redwood/issues/ML-3347
mira_ml: thanks team — keeping thread open until kernel patch/rollback lands. :thumbsup:
